The bowl looks about 15 cm across and holds white rice (probably sticky rice) topped with about 6 pieces of cantaloupe or papaya.

Rice: the layer is thin and mostly hidden. I estimate about 100 g cooked, which is roughly 130 kcal.

Fruit: the pieces are around 3-4 cm each. At roughly 25 g each, 6 pieces come to about 150 g. At about 0.35 kcal/g for cantaloupe, that is roughly 55 kcal.

Total: about 250 g of food and about 185 kcal. Sticky rice with coconut milk would run higher, so I'm rounding up to 200 kcal.
